summary: Synthetic MEDIUM-severity, CISA-KEV-listed vulnerability in pdos-kev-fixture 1.0.0 (test fixture).
details: Deterministic, hermetic OSV advisory used only by the pyforge-warden (Warden) KEV enrichment test suite (Story 6.4). Its OWN id is deliberately NOT CVE-shaped (mirrors real-world PyPI advisories, which are usually GHSA-/PYSEC-scoped) -- the CVE cross-reference lives only in `aliases`, proving KEV matching consults aliases, not just the primary id. `CVE-1970-00001` is a reserved-looking, obviously-fake CVE id chosen to never collide with a real advisory. The CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N vector empirically computes to base score 5.4 (osv-scanner 2.4.0, verified against the real binary) -- MEDIUM tier (warn by default), deliberately non-CRITICAL so a KEV match's forced policy-violation is provably independent of CVSS tier. Affects the synthetic PyPI package `pdos-kev-fixture` at the single explicit version 1.0.0. There is no such real package.
